content:
elaine: heads-up — we got a support ticket: provisional billing spike during a canary where a streaming toolcall was truncated then retried. looks like overlapping provisional emits.
ryan: session id?
elaine: sess=org-701, trace=t-9a1, happened 2026-03-27T09:45Z. console shows provisional=300, confirmed=150. two provisional writes ~210ms apart from different hosts.
ben: that matches the grace-window race we've seen. router allows a 450ms grace to avoid flapping; if a retry hits a different host before lease clears, both can emit provisional.
billing-bot: [alert] provisional-spike org-701 09:45 provisional=300 confirmed=150 :warning:
elaine: customer saw a false overage alert because alerting rules use provisional totals. they called support.
ryan: short-term: change alerting to ignore provisional-only spikes or require confirmation within 2m. product ok with a hotfix?
ben: product agreed for hotfix. long-term we need an idempotency + provenance approach. options: 1) tighten grace-window (breaks flapping), 2) dedupe provisional claims by (session, claim_nonce), 3) stable toolcall_id propagated across retries.
elaine: prefer 2+3. add claim_nonce generated by router on first provisional emit and toolcall_id persisted by sidecar/client during midstream retries.
ryan: agree. ingestion side can dedupe by (session_id, claim_nonce) and maintain a small Seen cache TTL=30m. also emit provenance fields in billing events: claim_nonce, claim_origin, toolcall_id.
ben: we'll need a feature flag in router to start emitting claim_nonce to canary. sidecar change to include toolcall_id on retry. ingestion accepts both old and new event schemas.
elaine: can we add an internal endpoint for oncall: /internal/billing/provenance?session=org-701&window=1h to inspect duplicate claims?
ryan: yes, small rate-limited JSON endpoint grouping by claim_nonce and claim_origin. will return counts and provisional token sums.
ben: pseudo query for triage:
```
SELECT claim_nonce, COUNT(*) cnt, SUM(provisional_tokens) p_tokens
FROM provisional_events
WHERE session_id='org-701' AND recorded_at > now() - interval '1 hour'
GROUP BY claim_nonce HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
```
elaine: console UX: mark provisional as "pending reconciliation" and exclude provisional-only numbers from alert triggers. add a provenance column in the session modal for quick RCA.
ryan: timeline: UX hotfix today (hide provisional from alerts), router flag to canary tomorrow, ingestion dedupe early next week, console provenance after backend stable.
ben: runbook note: "on provisional spike -> call /internal/billing/provenance -> look for duplicate claim_nonce/toolcall_id -> if duplicates, escalate to platform oncall and run on-demand reconcile".
elaine: I'll file tickets and notify the customer about reconciliation delay. owners: ryan=ingest+internal endpoint, ben=router+sidecar flag, elaine=console+alerts. :handshake:
